markets.thesis: Villarreal have the stronger attacking ceiling but the 1X2 market is close to fair at 50%; Under 3.5 gives more margin against a distribution concentrated around 2-3 total goals. User-confirmed market screenshot showed O3.5 38% / U3.5 62%.
markets.invalidation: Pass if Under 3.5 reprices to 66c+ or confirmed attacking lineups materially raise the expected-goals distribution.
